primary.title: Institutes of the Christian Religion
primary.author: John Calvin
primary.rationale: Calvin's magnum opus, a foundational text of Protestant theology. Multiple editions and translations are widely available.

primary.title: Commentaries on the Catholic Epistles
primary.author: John Calvin
primary.rationale: A significant portion of Calvin's exegetical work, demonstrating his biblical scholarship and theological method. Available in various collections.

primary.title: The Necessity of Reforming the Church
primary.author: John Calvin
primary.rationale: An important early work outlining Calvin's arguments for the Protestant Reformation, addressed to Emperor Charles V.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to John Calvin
secondary.author: Herman J. Selderhuis
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Calvin's life, thought, and influence. Published by a major academic press.

secondary.title: Calvin: A Life
secondary.author: Bruce Gordon
secondary.rationale: A highly regarded and comprehensive biography of John Calvin, offering a detailed account of his life and work. Published by a major academic press.

secondary.title: John Calvin's Institutes of the Christian Religion: A Guide for the Perplexed
secondary.author: David W. Hall
secondary.rationale: An accessible yet scholarly guide to understanding Calvin's most important work, suitable for students and researchers. Published by a reputable academic publisher.

suggestions.notes: Primary source texts, especially older translations of the Institutes, are widely available. Secondary sources focus on recent scholarly biographies and companions for comprehensive overviews.
